title: GitHub Portfolio Search
one_liner: Semantic search engine for personal GitHub repositories using embeddings and TF-IDF.
what_it_is: A tool that indexes GitHub repositories, extracts README content, generates embeddings, and provides a searchable interface via CLI, web UI, and MCP server. It helps developers find reusable code patterns and architectures across their own portfolio.
how_its_built: Python backend with FastAPI for the REST API, SQLite-vec for vector storage, sentence-transformers for embeddings, and a static HTML/JS frontend. Indexing is handled by a Python pipeline triggered locally or via GitHub Actions. Deployment uses AWS S3 and CloudFront.
how_to_apply: Clone the repo, install dependencies, configure a GitHub token, index your repos, and serve the web UI or use the CLI/MCP server to search your codebase semantically.
quickstart:
git clone https://github.com/davidbmar/github-portfolio-search.git
cd github-portfolio-search
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -e ".[dev]"
cp .env.example .env
# Edit .env to add GITHUB_TOKEN
ghps index <your_github_username>
ghps export
cd web && python3 -m http.server 8000
features: Semantic search using embeddings and TF-IDF across READMEs and code
Auto-generated capability clusters and related repo suggestions
CLI, Web UI, and MCP server interfaces for AI agents
Faceted filtering by language, tech stack, and stars
Automated weekly reindexing via GitHub Actions
Exportable search results and embeddable widget
